📌 Key points要点

⭐ Must know必须记住
  • NPVs: values that make the DENOMINATOR zero — factor it, set each factor =0.不允许值：使分母为零的值——把分母分解，每个因式 =0。
  • State NPVs from the ORIGINAL expression; a cancelled factor still counts.从原式写不允许值；约掉的因式照样算。
  • Cancel FACTORS, never terms; b−aa−b​=−1.只能约因式，不能约项；b−aa−b​=−1。

💡 x2+x−6x2−9​ and x−2x−3​ give the same output for almost every x — but at x=−3 the first one breaks. Knowing exactly where is half the marks.x2+x−6x2−9​ 和 x−2x−3​ 几乎对所有 x 都相等——但在 x=−3 处前者没有意义。准确找出这些点就拿到了一半的分。

  1. A rational expression is a fraction of polynomials. Its non-permissible values (NPVs) are the x-values that make the DENOMINATOR zero. Factor the denominator, set each factor =0.有理式是多项式之比。它的不允许值就是让分母为 0 的 x。把分母分解，令每个因式 =0。
  2. Find NPVs from the ORIGINAL expression, before cancelling. A cancelled factor still counts: the simplified form must carry the restriction.不允许值要从原式找，在约分之前。约掉的因式照样算数：化简后的式子必须带着限制条件。
  3. To simplify: factor top and bottom completely, then cancel common FACTORS (never terms).化简：分子分母都完全分解，再约去公因式（只能约因式，不能约项）。
  4. Opposites cancel to −1: b−aa−b​=−1. Spot pairs like (4−x) and (x−4).互为相反数的因式约成 −1：b−aa−b​=−1。注意 (4−x) 与 (x−4) 这种配对。

🧮 Key formulas关键公式

BCAC​=BA​,B=0, C=0
Cancelling a common factor约去公因式
b−aa−b​=−1,a=b
Opposite factors相反因式
🎯 Test tip考试提示
Write the NPVs on the first line, straight from the factored denominator, before you cancel anything. Answers without NPVs usually lose a mark even if the simplification is right.在第一行就从分解后的分母写出不允许值，然后再约分。即使化简正确，漏写不允许值通常也要扣分。

🧭 How to get started怎么入手

Ask yourself these five, in order, before writing anything. Every worked example on this page is labelled with them.动笔之前，按顺序问自己这五个问题。本页每道例题的步骤都标了它们。

  1. 🔎 Given已知
    Copy the denominator on its own and factor it completely. Factor the numerator too.把分母单独抄出来，彻底分解。分子也分解。
  2. 🎯 Asked求什么
    Two things: the non-permissible values, taken from the ORIGINAL denominator, and the simplest form with those NPVs written after it.两样东西：不允许值（从「原」分母找），以及最简式——后面要写上这些不允许值。
  3. ✏️ Picture it画出来
    A number line with an open circle at each NPV: the holes the expression can never use, even after cancelling.在数轴上把每个不允许值画成空心圈：这些「洞」即使约分以后也永远不能用。
  4. 🧰 Tool用什么工具
    Set each denominator factor =0 first. Then cancel only whole matching FACTORS; a pair like (3−x) and (x−3) cancels to −1.先令分母的每个因式 =0。然后只约完全相同的「因式」；像 (3−x) 和 (x−3) 这样的一对约成 −1。
  5. ✅ Check检验
    Choose an easy allowed value such as x=0 or x=1. The original and your answer must give the same number.挑一个允许的简单值，比如 x=0 或 x=1。原式和你的答案算出来必须是同一个数。

🧱 Prerequisite check先修检查

4 quick Grade 9–10 questions, about 3 minutes. Miss one and a 5-minute repair card opens right there; fix it, then carry on.4 道九、十年级小题，约 3 分钟。错了就在原地打开 5 分钟补救卡，补好再继续。

1Factoring x2+bx+c (product and sum)分解 x2+bx+c（积与和）
Factor x2−x−12.分解因式 x2−x−12。

🩹 5-minute repair5 分钟补一补 · Factoring x2+bx+c (product and sum)分解 x2+bx+c（积与和） (Grade年级 10)
Take out a common factor first. Then find two numbers that MULTIPLY to c and ADD to b: x2−x−12 → −4 and 3 → (x−4)(x+3). Check by expanding.先提公因式。再找两个数，相乘等于 c、相加等于 b：x2−x−12 → −4 和 3 → (x−4)(x+3)。展开检验。
  1. x2+7x+10: 2×5=10, 2+5=7 → (x+2)(x+5).x2+7x+10：2×5=10，2+5=7 → (x+2)(x+5)。
  2. If c<0 the two numbers have different signs; if c>0 they share the sign of b.若 c<0，两个数异号；若 c>0，两个数与 b 同号。
Try one:试一道：
Factor x2−2x−15.分解 x2−2x−15。

2Fractions: add, subtract, multiply, divide分数的四则运算
Write 2418​ in lowest terms.把 2418​ 化成最简分数。

🩹 5-minute repair5 分钟补一补 · Fractions: add, subtract, multiply, divide分数的四则运算 (Grade年级 7–9)
Add or subtract only with a common denominator: 21​+31​=63​+62​=65​. Multiply straight across. Divide = multiply by the reciprocal (flip the second fraction).加减必须先通分：21​+31​=63​+62​=65​。乘法分子乘分子、分母乘分母。除以一个分数＝乘它的倒数（把第二个分数倒过来）。
  1. 32​−41​: common denominator 12 → 128​−123​=125​.32​−41​：公分母 12 → 128​−123​=125​。
  2. 43​÷89​=43​⋅98​=3624​=32​.43​÷89​=43​⋅98​=3624​=32​。
  3. Never add denominators: 21​+31​=52​.分母不能相加：21​+31​=52​。
Try one:试一道：
Simplify 65​−41​.化简 65​−41​。

3Negative numbers: add, subtract, multiply负数的加减乘
Which expression equals −(x−5)?哪个式子等于 −(x−5)？

🩹 5-minute repair5 分钟补一补 · Negative numbers: add, subtract, multiply负数的加减乘 (Grade年级 7–9)
Subtracting a negative is adding: 5−(−3)=5+3=8. Same signs multiply to +, different signs to −. Squaring a negative is positive: (−4)2=16, but −42=−16 (the square happens first).减去负数等于加上它：5−(−3)=5+3=8。同号相乘得正，异号相乘得负。负数的平方是正的：(−4)2=16，但 −42=−16（先算平方）。
  1. −7−(−2): change "minus negative" to "plus": −7+2=−5.−7−(−2)：把「减负」改成「加」：−7+2=−5。
  2. (−3)(−5)=15 (same signs), (−3)(5)=−15 (different signs).(−3)(−5)=15（同号），(−3)(5)=−15（异号）。
  3. Plugging in x=−3 to x2: write brackets first, (−3)2=9.把 x=−3 代入 x2：先加括号，(−3)2=9。
Try one:试一道：
Evaluate b2−4ac when a=2, b=−3, c=−1.当 a=2, b=−3, c=−1 时，求 b2−4ac。

4Solving a linear equation解一元一次方程
Solve 2x+7=0.解 2x+7=0。

🩹 5-minute repair5 分钟补一补 · Solving a linear equation解一元一次方程 (Grade年级 8–9)
Do the same thing to both sides. Clear brackets, collect x on one side and numbers on the other, then divide. With fractions, multiply every term by the common denominator first.两边做同样的事。先去括号，把含 x 的项移到一边、数字移到另一边，最后除以系数。有分数时先把每一项都乘以公分母。
  1. 3(x−2)=x+8 → 3x−6=x+8 → 2x=14 → x=7.3(x−2)=x+8 → 3x−6=x+8 → 2x=14 → x=7。
  2. 2x​+3x​=5: multiply every term by 6 → 3x+2x=30 → x=6.2x​+3x​=5：每项乘 6 → 3x+2x=30 → x=6。
  3. Check by substituting: 3(7−2)=15 and 7+8=15 ✓.代回检验：3(7−2)=15，7+8=15 ✓。
Try one:试一道：
Solve 4x−1​=6x​.解 4x−1​=6x​。

🪜 Worked → fill in → your turn例题 → 填空 → 自己做

Three versions of one idea: read a full solution, then finish a half-done one, then do one yourself with hints you open one at a time.同一个思路的三个版本：先看完整解答，再补全半成品，最后自己做——提示一次只开一个。

① Worked example — read it完整例题——看懂
Simplify x2−9x2−5x+6​ and state the NPVs.化简 x2−9x2−5x+6​，并写出不允许值。
  1. 🔎 Given已知
    Bottom: x2−9=(x−3)(x+3). Top: x2−5x+6=(x−2)(x−3).分母：x2−9=(x−3)(x+3)。分子：x2−5x+6=(x−2)(x−3)。
  2. 🎯 Asked求什么
    NPVs from the original bottom: x=3 and x=−3. Write them now.由原分母得不允许值：x=3，x=−3。现在就写下来。
  3. 🧰 Tool用什么工具
    Cancel the common factor (x−3): x+3x−2​.约去公因式 (x−3)：x+3x−2​。
  4. ✅ Check检验
    At x=0: original −96​=−32​; answer 3−2​=−32​ ✓.取 x=0：原式 −96​=−32​；答案 3−2​=−32​ ✓。
✔
x+3x−2​, x=±3x+3x−2​，x=±3
② Same idea — you fill the gaps同一思路——你来补空
Simplify x2−16x2+x−12​ and state the NPVs.化简 x2−16x2+x−12​，并写出不允许值。
  1. 🔎 Given已知
    Bottom: x2−16=(x−4)(x+4). Top: x2+x−12=(x+4)(x−3).分母：x2−16=(x−4)(x+4)。分子：x2+x−12=(x+4)(x−3)。
  2. 🎯 Asked求什么
    ✍️
    Your turn: write the NPVs before cancelling anything.轮到你：约分之前先写出不允许值。
    x=4 and x=−4.x=4，x=−4。
  3. 🧰 Tool用什么工具
    ✍️
    Your turn: cancel the common factor.轮到你：约去公因式。
    Cancel (x+4): x−4x−3​.约去 (x+4)：x−4x−3​。
  4. ✅ Check检验
    At x=0: original −16−12​=43​; answer −4−3​=43​ ✓.取 x=0：原式 −16−12​=43​；答案 −4−3​=43​ ✓。
Answer答案
x−4x−3​, x=±4x−4x−3​，x=±4
③ Your turn — on paper first轮到你——先在纸上做
Simplify x2−x−615−5x​ and state the NPVs.化简 x2−x−615−5x​，并写出不允许值。
  1. 🔎 Given已知
    Factor the bottom first: two numbers with product −6 and sum −1.先分解分母：找积为 −6、和为 −1 的两个数。
  2. 🎯 Asked求什么
    (x−3)(x+2), so x=3 and x=−2. Now look at the top.(x−3)(x+2)，所以 x=3，x=−2。现在看分子。
  3. 🧰 Tool用什么工具
    Take out −5 so the bracket matches: 15−5x=−5(x−3).提出 −5，让括号对上：15−5x=−5(x−3)。
  4. ✅ Check检验
    Check your answer at x=0: the original gives −615​=−25​.用 x=0 检验答案：原式得 −615​=−25​。
−x+25​, x=3, −2−x+25​，x=3, −2
  1. 🔎 Given已知
    Bottom x2−x−6=(x−3)(x+2): NPVs x=3, −2.分母 x2−x−6=(x−3)(x+2)：不允许值 x=3, −2。
  2. 🧰 Tool用什么工具
    Top 15−5x=−5(x−3). Cancel (x−3): x+2−5​.分子 15−5x=−5(x−3)。约去 (x−3)：x+2−5​。
  3. ✅ Check检验
    At x=0: 2−5​=−25​, same as the original ✓.取 x=0：2−5​=−25​，与原式相同 ✓。
How did it go?做得怎样？
✏️ More worked examples, harder ones too更多例题（含更难的）
Example 1例 1L1 Know知道
Find the non-permissible values of x2−9x+4​ and 2x2+x−65​.求 x2−9x+4​ 和 2x2+x−65​ 的不允许值。
  1. 🧰 Tool用什么工具
    x2−9=(x−3)(x+3), so x=3 and x=−3. (The numerator does not matter.)x2−9=(x−3)(x+3)，所以 x=3 且 x=−3。（分子不影响。）
  2. 🧰 Tool用什么工具
    2x2+x−6=(2x−3)(x+2), so x=23​ and x=−2.2x2+x−6=(2x−3)(x+2)，所以 x=23​ 且 x=−2。
Answer答案
x=±3;x=23​,−2
🧭 What this example trains这道题练什么
🎯 Goal考查目标
Find the values that make a denominator zero by factoring it.通过分解分母求使分母为零的值。
📚 Knowledge used用到的知识
Non-permissible values & simplifying不允许值与化简Difference of squares & perfect squares平方差与完全平方Factoring trinomials ax²+bx+c三项式 ax²+bx+c 的分解
💪 Abilities锻炼的能力
⚙️ Fluent procedures运算熟练📘 Concepts概念理解
💡 Key idea解题思路
Factor the denominator and set each factor to zero; the numerator is irrelevant for NPVs.分解分母，令每个因式为零；求不允许值与分子无关。
🔀 Other ways to think不同的思考方式
  • Factor with difference of squares or the trinomial method, then read off the zeros.用平方差或三项式分解法，再读出各零点。
  • Solve denominator =0 by the quadratic formula when it does not factor easily.分母不好分解时，用求根公式解分母 =0。
Example 2例 2L2 Apply会做2 methods种解法
Simplify x2−1612−3x​ and state the NPVs.化简 x2−1612−3x​，并写出不允许值。
  1. 🔎 Given已知
    NPVs: x2−16=(x−4)(x+4), so x=±4.不允许值：x2−16=(x−4)(x+4)，所以 x=±4。
  2. 🧰 Tool用什么工具
    Top: 12−3x=−3(x−4), so the factor matches the bottom exactly.分子：12−3x=−3(x−4)，因式与分母完全一致。
  3. 🧰 Tool用什么工具
    (x−4)(x+4)−3(x−4)​=x+4−3​, x=±4.(x−4)(x+4)−3(x−4)​=x+4−3​，x=±4。
  1. 🧰 Tool用什么工具
    Top: 12−3x=3(4−x). Bottom: (x−4)(x+4).分子：12−3x=3(4−x)。分母：(x−4)(x+4)。
  2. 🧰 Tool用什么工具
    x−44−x​=−1, so the result is 3⋅(−1)⋅x+41​=−x+43​, x=±4.x−44−x​=−1，所以结果是 3⋅(−1)⋅x+41​=−x+43​，x=±4。
Answer答案
−x+43​, x=±4

💡 Key idea解题思路
Factor 12−3x as −3(x−4) so that (x−4) cancels; NPVs come from the ORIGINAL denominator.把 12−3x 写成 −3(x−4)，约去 (x−4)；不允许值要看原来的分母。

Example 3例 3L3 Connect会用
Simplify 9−4x26x2−7x−3​ and state all non-permissible values.化简 9−4x26x2−7x−3​，写出全部不允许值。
  1. 🔎 Given已知
    Bottom first (NPVs come from here): 9−4x2=(3−2x)(3+2x), so x=23​ and x=−23​.先分母（不允许值来自这里）：9−4x2=(3−2x)(3+2x)，所以 x=23​，x=−23​。
  2. 🧰 Tool用什么工具
    Top by decomposition: ac=−18, sum −7: −9 and 2. 6x2−9x+2x−3=3x(2x−3)+1(2x−3)=(2x−3)(3x+1).分子用拆项法：ac=−18，和 −7：−9 和 2。6x2−9x+2x−3=3x(2x−3)+1(2x−3)=(2x−3)(3x+1)。
  3. 🧰 Tool用什么工具
    (2x−3) on top and (3−2x) on the bottom are opposites: 3−2x2x−3​=−1.分子的 (2x−3) 和分母的 (3−2x) 互为相反数：3−2x2x−3​=−1。
  4. 🎯 Asked求什么
    Result: −2x+33x+1​, with x=±23​. Keep x=23​ even though that factor disappeared.结果：−2x+33x+1​，x=±23​。虽然那个因式约掉了，x=23​ 仍要保留。
  5. ✅ Check检验
    Quick check at x=0: original 9−3​=−31​; simplified −31​ ✓.用 x=0 验算：原式 9−3​=−31​；化简式 −31​ ✓。
Answer答案
−2x+33x+1​, x=±23​
🧭 What this example trains这道题练什么
🎯 Goal考查目标
Factor a trinomial and a difference of squares in opposite orientation, cancel, and list all NPVs.分解三项式与方向相反的平方差，约分，并列出全部不允许值。
📚 Knowledge used用到的知识
Non-permissible values & simplifying不允许值与化简Factoring trinomials ax²+bx+c三项式 ax²+bx+c 的分解Difference of squares & perfect squares平方差与完全平方
💪 Abilities锻炼的能力
🧭 Choosing a strategy选择策略⚙️ Fluent procedures运算熟练🔍 Checking & reasoning检验与推理
💡 Key idea解题思路
9−4x2=−(2x−3)(2x+3); match the opposite bracket (3−2x) with (2x−3).9−4x2=−(2x−3)(2x+3)；把 (3−2x) 与 (2x−3) 配成相反式。
🔀 Other ways to think不同的思考方式
  • Factor both and cancel the opposite pair, tracking the minus sign.两边都分解，约去相反式，注意负号。
  • Rewrite the denominator as 4x2−9 with a −1 out front, then factor.先把分母改写成 −(4x2−9)，再分解。

🔍 Common mistakes常见错误

Someone made each of these. Tap the line where it first goes wrong.每道题都有人这样做过。点出第一处出错的那一行。

1Cancelling terms instead of factors约掉的是项，不是因式
Simplify x2+3xx2+4x​ and state the NPVs.化简 x2+3xx2+4x​，并写出不允许值。

🧠 The x2 is added to something, not multiplied, so it is a term, not a factor. Only factors that MULTIPLY the whole top and the whole bottom can cancel.x2 是和别的式子相加的，是「项」不是「因式」。只有乘在整个分子和整个分母上的因式才能约。

🔧 Factor first: x(x+3)x(x+4)​, NPVs x=0, −3; cancel x: x+3x+4​. (At x=1: 45​, not 34​.)先分解：x(x+3)x(x+4)​，不允许值 x=0, −3；约去 x：x+3x+4​。（x=1 时是 45​，不是 34​。）

✔ x+3x+4​, x=0, −3x+3x+4​，x=0, −3

2Taking the NPVs from the simplified form从化简后的式子找不允许值
Simplify x2+2x−15x2−25​ and state the NPVs.化简 x2+2x−15x2−25​，并写出不允许值。

🧠 The NPV was read off the bottom AFTER (x+5) was cancelled, so x=−5 disappeared. At x=−5 the original is 00​, which is undefined.不允许值是在约掉 (x+5) 之后才看分母的，所以 x=−5 丢了。x=−5 时原式是 00​，没有意义。

🔧 Write the NPVs from the factored original bottom (x+5)(x−3): x=−5, 3.从分解后的原分母 (x+5)(x−3) 写不允许值：x=−5, 3。

✔ x−3x−5​, x=−5, 3x−3x−5​，x=−5, 3

🔗 The same mistake is a wrong option in:同一个错误也是这些题的错误选项： Check-up测评 Q1 B, Check-up测评 Q2 B

3Using the numerator to find NPVs用分子去找不允许值
State the NPVs of x2−6xx2−4​.写出 x2−6xx2−4​ 的不允许值。

🧠 A zero on top is allowed; the value of the fraction is just 0. Only division by zero is a problem, so only the bottom matters.分子为零是允许的，分式的值就是 0。只有除以零才出问题，所以只看分母。

🔧 Bottom: x2−6x=x(x−6), so x=0 and x=6.分母：x2−6x=x(x−6)，所以 x=0，x=6。

✔ x=0, 6

🔗 The same mistake is a wrong option in:同一个错误也是这些题的错误选项： Check-up测评 Q1 A

4Treating opposite factors as equal把相反因式当成相同因式
Simplify x2−93−x​ and state the NPVs.化简 x2−93−x​，并写出不允许值。

🧠 3−x and x−3 are opposites, not equal: at x=5 they are −2 and 2. Opposites cancel to −1, not to 1.3−x 和 x−3 互为相反数，并不相等：x=5 时分别是 −2 和 2。相反因式约成 −1，不是 1。

🔧 3−x=−(x−3), so the result is −x+31​, x=±3. (At x=0: −93​=−31​ ✓.)3−x=−(x−3)，所以结果是 −x+31​，x=±3。（x=0 时：−93​=−31​ ✓。）

✔ −x+31​, x=±3−x+31​，x=±3

🔗 The same mistake is a wrong option in:同一个错误也是这些题的错误选项： Check-up测评 Q2 A, Practice练习 7

5Sign slip when taking out a negative提负号时符号出错
Simplify x2−8x+168−2x​ and state the NPV.化简 x2−8x+168−2x​，并写出不允许值。

🧠 Taking out −2 flips the sign of EVERY term inside: −2(x+4)=−2x−8, not 8−2x.提出 −2 时，括号里「每一项」都要变号：−2(x+4)=−2x−8，不是 8−2x。

🔧 8−2x=−2(x−4) (check: −2x+8 ✓). Cancel one (x−4): −x−42​, x=4.8−2x=−2(x−4)（检验：−2x+8 ✓）。约去一个 (x−4)：−x−42​，x=4。

✔ −x−42​, x=4−x−42​，x=4

🔗 The same mistake is a wrong option in:同一个错误也是这些题的错误选项： Practice练习 6

⚠️ Quick list速查

  • Cancelling terms instead of factors: x+3x+6​=36​. Only something MULTIPLIED on top and bottom can cancel.约掉的是项不是因式：x+3x+6​=36​。只有分子分母中「相乘」的公因式才能约。
  • Finding NPVs after simplifying — the cancelled factor’s restriction gets lost. Always state them from the original.化简之后才找不允许值——约掉的因式的限制就丢了。一定从原式写出。
  • Setting the NUMERATOR to zero for NPVs. A zero numerator is fine (the expression is just 0).令分子为 0 求不允许值。分子为 0 没问题（式子的值就是 0）。

Example 3例 3: Simplify 9−4x26x2−7x−3​ and state all non-permissible values.化简 9−4x26x2−7x−3​，写出全部不允许值。

💡 Why it works为什么成立

WCLN - Math - Non-permissible values
WCLN · 4 min · ↗
It gives the one idea behind every non-permissible value: set the denominator to zero and solve. It only uses simple denominators, so after it, try the factored ones in our examples; for a denominator like x2−9 you set it to zero and get two values.它讲清了所有「不允许的值」背后的唯一想法：令分母等于零再解方程。它只用了简单的分母，看完后再去做我们例题里要先分解的分母；像 x2−9 这样的分母，令它等于零会得到两个值。
⏩ From 0:00 (about 3 minutes): you cannot divide by zero, so x3​ only makes sense when x=0. 1:40 two more: 4x5​ gives x=0, and 3+x11​ gives x=−3 (2:04: set the denominator equal to 0 and solve; 2:44 check by putting −3 in: 3+(−3)=0).从 0:00 开始（约 3 分钟）：不能除以零，所以 x3​ 只有在 x=0 时才有意义。1:40 再看两个例子：4x5​ 得 x=0，3+x11​ 得 x=−3（2:04 的做法：令分母等于 0 再解方程；2:44 把 −3 代进去检验：3+(−3)=0）。

🪜 Step by step一步一步

Intro to Rational Expressions & Restrictions • [6.1a] Pre-Calculus 11
the AllAroundMathGuy · 7 min · ↗
This is the cleanest short explanation of non-permissible values: set the denominator not equal to zero, solve it like an equation, and factor when it is a quadratic. It covers only the restriction half of our topic and never cancels a common factor, so do the simplifying part from the worked examples. When you do simplify, find the NPVs from the denominator before you cancel anything, because cancelling hides them. Note that the x2+4 example works only because we are in the real numbers.这是讲「非允许值」最干净的短视频：令分母不等于 0，像解方程一样解出来，遇到二次式就先因式分解。它只讲了这个主题里「限制条件」那一半，完全没有约分，所以约分的部分请看例题。真正化简时，要先从原来的分母求出限制条件再约分，因为约分之后限制条件就看不见了。注意 x2+4 这个例子只在实数范围内成立。
⏩ From 0:00 to about 6:20 (6 minutes, restrictions only). 0:58 why a denominator cannot be zero. 2:00 six examples: x2​ gives x=0; x−3x+2​ gives x=3 (the numerator can be zero, only the denominator cannot); 7−4x⋅​ gives x=47​=1.75; a fraction with only a 5 in the denominator has no restriction; x2+3x−4=(x+4)(x−1)=0 gives x=−4 and x=1; x2+4 is never 0, so no restriction.从 0:00 到约 6:20（共 6 分钟，只讲限制条件）。0:58 为什么分母不能是 0。2:00 起六个例子：x2​ 得 x=0；x−3x+2​ 得 x=3（分子可以是 0，只有分母不行）；分母为 7−4x 时 x=47​=1.75；分母只有 5 的分式没有限制；x2+3x−4=(x+4)(x−1)=0 得 x=−4 且 x=1；x2+4 永远不是 0，所以没有限制。
Simplifying Rational Expressions
The Organic Chemistry Tutor · 10 min · ↗
It shows the routine our topic needs: factor the top and bottom completely, then cancel only the common factors. The x−55−x​=−1 case is one students rarely meet in class but often meet on a test.它演示了这一节需要的固定流程：上下都分解到底，再只约去公因式。x−55−x​=−1 这种情形课上很少讲，考试里却常出现。
⏩ From 0:00 to about 8:35 (about 8.5 minutes; it never mentions non-permissible values, so find those yourself from the original denominator). 0:07 49x235x5​=75x3​. 1:24 take out the common factor first: 3x+64x2+8x​=34x​. 2:13 x2+9x+20x2−16​=x+5x−4​. 3:26 x−55−x​=−1 (factor −1 out of one side). 7:11 2x2−18x2−8x+15​=2(x+3)x−5​ (take out the 2 first, then a difference of squares).从 0:00 看到约 8:35（约 8.5 分钟；视频里完全没提不允许的值，要自己从原来的分母去找）：0:07 49x235x5​=75x3​。1:24 先提公因数：3x+64x2+8x​=34x​。2:13 x2+9x+20x2−16​=x+5x−4​。3:26 x−55−x​=−1（把 −1 从一边提出来）。7:11 2x2−18x2−8x+15​=2(x+3)x−5​（先提 2，再用平方差）。

🔍 Common mistakes常见错误

Common Algebra Errors - Simplifying Rational Expressions
smwlsn · 6 min · ↗
Cancelling a term across a plus sign is the most common wrong move in this topic, and the number test (put in x=1 or any easy number and compare) is a check you can use on a test. It does not cover non-permissible values, so pair it with the video above.隔着加号约项是这一节最常见的错误，而且「代入一个简单的数字比较一下」是考试时能用的验算办法。它没有讲不允许的值，要和上一个视频配合着看。
⏩ From 0:00 to about 2:20 (after that he moves to adding fractions, a different unit): why you cannot cancel 2x in 2x+12x−3​ to get −3. 0:34 test the same idea with numbers: 2+12−3​=−31​, not −3. 1:37 the rule: you may cancel only common factors (parts of a product), never terms (parts of a sum), so this expression is already simplified.从 0:00 看到约 2:20 就够了（后面转去讲分式加法，是别的单元）：为什么不能把 2x+12x−3​ 里的 2x 约掉得到 −3。0:34 用数字试同一个想法：2+12−3​=−31​，不是 −3。1:37 规则：只能约去公因式（乘积里的部分），不能约项（加减里的部分），所以这个式子已经是最简。

1. Non-permissible values of (x−2)(x+3)x+1​.(x−2)(x+3)x+1​ 的不允许值。
x ≠ and x ≠
The numerator being zero (x=−1) is allowed. Only the denominator matters.分子为零（x=−1）是允许的。只有分母为零才不行。

✔ x ≠ -3 and x ≠ 2

The denominator is zero at x=2 and x=−3.分母在 x=2 和 x=−3 时为零。

2. Simplify x2−x−6x2−9​.化简 x2−x−6x2−9​。
( x + ) / ( x + )
Factors of x2−9 are (x−3)(x+3): cancel (x−3) and keep (x+3).x2−9=(x−3)(x+3)：约去 (x−3)，留下 (x+3)。

✔ ( x + 3 ) / ( x + 2 ) x+2x+3​

(x−3)(x+2)(x−3)(x+3)​=x+2x+3​.(x−3)(x+2)(x−3)(x+3)​=x+2x+3​。

3. Non-permissible values for the ORIGINAL expression x2−x−6x2−9​.原式 x2−x−6x2−9​ 的不允许值。
x ≠ and x ≠
You also need x=3: the cancelled factor (x−3) was in the original denominator.还要 x=3：约掉的因式 (x−3) 原来就在分母里。

✔ x ≠ -2 and x ≠ 3

Factor the original denominator: (x−3)(x+2), so x=3 and x=−2. The 3 stays excluded even after cancelling.把原分母分解：(x−3)(x+2)，所以 x=3 且 x=−2。约分之后 3 仍要排除。

4. Find the non-permissible value of 2x−65​.求 2x−65​ 的不允许值。
Solve 2x−6=0: x=+3.解 2x−6=0：x=+3。
Divide by the 2 as well: 2x=6, x=3.还要除以 2：2x=6，x=3。

✔ 3

2x−6=0 gives x=3.2x−6=0 得 x=3。

5. Is x+3x+3​ equal to 1?x+3x+3​ 等于 1 吗？

✔ Yes, except at x=−3是，除了 x=−3

It equals 1 whenever it is defined; at x=−3 the denominator is 0.只要有意义它就等于 1；x=−3 时分母为 0。

🗣️ Explain it back用自己的话讲一遍

Why do we write the non-permissible values BEFORE cancelling factors?为什么要在约分之前先写出不允许值？

After cancelling, the removed factor is gone and you can no longer see the number that made the original denominator zero. x2−x−6x2−9​ is still undefined at x=3 even though the simplified x+2x+3​ is fine there.约分之后，被约掉的因式不见了，就看不出原来让分母为零的数。x2−x−6x2−9​ 在 x=3 时仍然没有意义，尽管化简后的 x+2x+3​ 在那里没问题。

x+3x+5​, x=±3x+3x+5​，x=±3
  1. Cancel (x−3): x+3x+5​. NPVs from the original: x=3,−3.约去 (x−3)：x+3x+5​。原式的不允许值：x=3,−3。

8L4 Solve会想🌍 Modelling建模🔍 Checking & reasoning检验与推理🔗 Connecting ideas知识联系
A club rents a hall. Its average cost per member (in hundreds of dollars) is modelled by A(n)=n2−9n2+2n−15​, where n is the number of members. (a) Simplify A(n) and state all non-permissible values. (b) A treasurer enters n=3 into the simplified form and reports $133 per member. Explain why the original model gives no answer at n=3, so the report cannot be trusted. (c) Find A(5) both ways, and say what A(n) approaches when the club becomes very large.某俱乐部租一个场地，每位会员的平均费用（以百加元计）建模为 A(n)=n2−9n2+2n−15​，其中 n 是会员人数。(a) 化简 A(n) 并写出所有不允许值。(b) 财务把 n=3 代入化简式，报告每人 $133。解释为什么原模型在 n=3 时没有答案，所以这个报告不可信。(c) 用两种方式求 A(5)，并说明会员很多时 A(n) 趋近于什么。
Factor both parts. For the long-run value rewrite n+3n+5​=1+n+32​.两部分都分解。求长期值时把 n+3n+5​ 改写成 1+n+32​。
(a) A(n)=n+3n+5​, n=±3; (b) the original has denominator 0 at n=3; (c) A(5)=45​ ($125), tending to 1 ($100).(a) A(n)=n+3n+5​，n=±3；(b) 原式在 n=3 时分母为 0；(c) A(5)=45​（$125），趋近于 1（$100）。
  1. (n−3)(n+3)(n+5)(n−3)​=n+3n+5​, with n=3 and n=−3 from the original denominator.(n−3)(n+3)(n+5)(n−3)​=n+3n+5​，原分母给出 n=3 和 n=−3。
  2. At n=3 the original is 00​, undefined; the simplified form gives 68​=34​ (that is $133), but that value belongs to the simplified expression, not to the model. The model has a hole there.n=3 时原式是 00​，无意义；化简式给出 68​=34​（即 $133），但这个值属于化简式，不属于原模型。原模型在该点有一个「洞」。
  3. A(5)=25−925+10−15​=1620​=45​ from the original, and 810​=45​ from the simplified form: $125 per member.A(5) 用原式：25−925+10−15​=1620​=45​；用化简式：810​=45​。结果相同，每人 $125。
  4. As n grows, n+32​→0, so A(n)→1, about $100 per member.n 越大，n+32​→0，所以 A(n)→1，约每人 $100。
🎯 Goal考查目标
Simplify a cost model, keep its restrictions, and interpret a hole and long-run behaviour in context.化简费用模型，保留限制条件，并在情境中解释「洞」与长期趋势。
📚 Knowledge used用到的知识

💪 Abilities锻炼的能力
🌍 Modelling建模🔍 Checking & reasoning检验与推理🔗 Connecting ideas知识联系
💡 Key idea解题思路
Simplifying does not remove a restriction; the original expression defines the model.化简不会消除限制条件；原式才定义了这个模型。
🔀 Other ways to think不同的思考方式
  • Factor top and bottom, cancel, keep NPVs from the original.分子分母分解、约分，不允许值取自原式。
  • Numerical check: compute A(4), A(5), A(100) from the original and see the pattern.数值检验：用原式算 A(4)、A(5)、A(100)，观察规律。
  • Long division view: n+3n+5​=1+n+32​.带余形式：n+3n+5​=1+n+32​。
